name: target_tractability_assessment
description: Multi-criteria target tractability scoring for small molecule and biologic drug discovery campaigns. Evaluates protein family classification, binding pocket geometry, literature precedent, and druggability index to triage and prioritize candidate drug targets before compound screening investment. Returns per-target tractability scores, biologic modality assessments, and pocket geometry metrics. NOT for protein folding or 3D structure prediction — this is a druggability scoring pipeline, not a structure predictor.
example_queries: target tractability scoring for small molecule and biologic drug discovery
assess druggability of candidate protein targets
rank therapeutic targets by tractability and pocket score
druggability assessment for drug discovery campaign
